summary: Configured node1 to serve secure-os-comparison-ready at https://10.100.153.10:8443/ using nginx and a system-trusted certificate. Verified successful recovery after reboot.
actions_performed: Generated a local CA and server certificate on node1, added the CA to Debian's system trust store, and protected private keys with root-only permissions.
Configured nginx to listen on TCP 8443 and serve the required response.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns the required content using system trust
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, nginx listened on 8443; system certificate verification succeeded for the node IP and DNS name; verified curl returned secure-os-comparison-ready, HTTP 200, remote IP 10.100.153.10, and ssl_verify_result=0.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID cd201c7e-7a27-4b28-a631-737e59cba357, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 7eadf082-b4ce-4082-984c-80bbb2ad71d0, then proved nginx, configuration, persisted content, listener, certificate trust, and HTTPS response recovered.
